test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Although I have a good job, I wish to take the ________ of starting my own business.
solution:
The correct answer is **risk**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the blank is **'Risk'.**
 
• **Take a risk** is a **phrase** that means** 'to do something although you know that something unpleasant or dangerous could happen'**.
 
 
• ***Example: **A good pilot never **takes a risk**.*​
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Back: **the part or side of something that is furthest from the front. (पीछे का भाग, पीछे की ओर)
 
• **Seat: **something that you sit on. (बैठने का आसन)
 
• **Look: **to try to find (somebody/something). ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का) पता लगाने की कोशिश करना)

18c:T87a,

The correct answer is **change**.
